sourceScope: The fixture mounts the production styleguide and registered real DMenubar examples from the exact source commit. The copied bundle only changes its Info.plist identity and ad-hoc signature; repository runner identities and entitlements are unchanged.

inspection.note: The independent reviewer compared the official rendered light reference and inspected the preceding exact-source native bundle across interaction, light/dark/Plum, RTL, 360px, 200% text and reduced motion. That pass found an off-screen focused-trigger issue, fixed in this source commit. This rebuilt exact bundle is queued for the required post-fix native confirmation before acceptance.
